Version: 0.9.5-debian-dpanel.1
Source commit: 847ab23d913f89648d3dc3a5c52798b6384266c4
Target: Linux amd64, CGO_ENABLED=0, Go 1.24.1, statically linked.
Embedded VCS revision matches source; vcs.modified=false.

Changes:
- Prefer nonempty custom_config over calendar version inference, respecting DisableCustomConfig.
- Decode DPanel numeric ports and boolean/numeric flags alongside legacy SSPanel strings.
- Validate ports and reject truncated legacy server formats without index panics.
- Disable node-status POST after HTTP 405 for the process; user/traffic reporting is unchanged.

Validation:
- All modules verified against go.sum.
- SSPanel/DPanel HTTP fixture tests and legacy parser regressions passed, including race detector.
- Limiter race tests passed.
- Selected mylego and V2ray/Trojan/Shadowsocks builder tests passed.
- 13 installer/bootstrap/upgrade fixture tests passed.
- Binary smoke test against a mock DPanel 1.0.0 response: created local VLESS/REALITY
  inbound using a synthetic local key, loaded a fixture user, and remained running.
- HTTP core forwarded 1,245,184 bytes intact; node-status POST 405 was handled once.
- This is not a VLESS/REALITY client handshake or a WAN throughput measurement.
- Real user panel, real VPS/kernel update and reboot remain untested here.
